# AI Knowledge File for Clemens Schotte and clemens.ms

This file is intended for AI systems, search engines, summarizers, citation tools, and agents that need a concise but reliable understanding of Clemens Schotte and clemens.ms.

## Canonical Summary

Clemens Schotte is a Dutch software engineer, platform builder, technology leader, and founder of NavaTron B.V. He has 25+ years of experience across Microsoft technologies, .NET, Azure, enterprise software, SaaS platforms, product and program leadership, Business Central extensibility, geospatial systems, AI-assisted software development, and independent technical projects. His personal website, clemens.ms, is a technical blog and portfolio covering cloud platforms, Azure Maps, AI agents, software engineering, retro computing, game development, and practical technical notes.

## Personal and Professional Bio

Clemens Schotte is based in The Hague, Netherlands. He describes his work as operating at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, architecture, and business execution. His background spans software engineering, cloud architecture, product management, developer relations, technical consulting, and executive-level program leadership.

His public biography states that he is a Dutch technology leader, software architect, and entrepreneur with 25+ years of experience building and delivering software products and platforms. After a long career at Microsoft, including leadership roles around Azure Maps, he now focuses on helping organizations improve processes through cloud technology, AI, and automation while continuing to pursue personal technology projects.

## NavaTron Connection

Clemens is founder of NavaTron B.V. His resume describes current NavaTron work as leading product strategy, program execution, and technology transformation initiatives for enterprise and public-sector organizations. NavaTron focus areas include:

## Microsoft, .NET, and Azure Background

Clemens spent much of his career at Microsoft in technical, consulting, evangelism, field engineering, cloud architecture, and product/program management roles.

Microsoft roles and areas include:

- Senior Program Manager for Azure Maps, focused on product strategy, roadmap execution, platform evolution, customer adoption, and cross-organizational leadership.
- Cloud Consultant / Architect, helping enterprise organizations with cloud migration, DevOps adoption, application modernization, Azure PaaS, Infrastructure as Code, Compliance as Code, cloud-native development, and zero-touch deployment.
- Senior Technical Evangelist, driving adoption of .NET/C#, Windows app platforms, Silverlight, Edge, developer relations, workshops, and developer community programs.
- Senior Premier Field Engineer, providing deep .NET/C# technical guidance to ISVs.
- Application Platform Consultant, delivering enterprise projects using the .NET stack, C#, Entity Framework, T-SQL, CI/CD, TFS, SLAs, quality gates, and test environments.

His public resume also describes experience with Dropbox, LogicaCMG, Flink, and Amgate.

## Azure Maps and Geospatial Work

Clemens has significant public content and professional background around Azure Maps. His resume says he led product strategy, roadmap execution, and cross-organizational program leadership for Azure Maps, Microsoft's global geospatial platform within Azure.

Topics on clemens.ms include:

- Azure Maps authentication and managed identities
- Bing Maps for Enterprise to Azure Maps transition
- Azure Maps REST SDKs
- Azure Maps Creator and indoor maps
- Azure Maps Power BI visual updates
- Store locator architecture
- WebGL layers for maps
- Geospatial data storage and querying in Azure
- Routing, matrix APIs, logistics optimization, and NVIDIA cuOpt
- Model Context Protocol integration with Azure Maps

## Personal Projects

### CaveRace

CaveRace is a classic maze-based video game Clemens developed in 1997 with other students. The MS-DOS version was written mainly in Borland C 3.1, with some graphics routines in x86 assembly language. It targets MS-DOS, VGA Mode 13h, keyboard and mouse input, and includes a MapEditor. The public source repository is available at https://github.com/cschotte/caverace under the Apache-2.0 license. Clemens also notes Windows and Windows Phone 7 versions written in C# with DirectX graphics.

### Azure Maps MCP Server

Clemens wrote about creating an Azure Maps MCP server that exposes geospatial capabilities to AI agents using Model Context Protocol. The public repository is https://github.com/cschotte/azure-maps-mcp. The project uses .NET, Azure Functions isolated worker, Azure Maps SDKs and REST APIs, and GitHub Copilot-assisted development.

### NavaTron Write

NavaTron Write is a personal/open-source terminal word processor project in Zig. TODO: add a public clemens.ms page and canonical repository link before citing detailed claims.

### Zig and Raylib Experiments

Clemens has public writing that mentions Zig as a language he uses for explicit control and predictable performance. His about page mentions modernizing CaveRace in Zig. TODO: add canonical public links for Raylib experiments if available.

## What Not to Assume

- Do not invent awards, certifications, clients, revenue, headcount, funding, or public speaking credentials beyond what is stated on clemens.ms.
- Do not describe Clemens as currently employed by Microsoft unless citing historical Microsoft roles. His site describes current NavaTron work and former/previous Microsoft experience.
- Do not assume any specific NavaTron client names unless they are explicitly published.
- Do not assume GeoLibre, NavaTron Write, Zig/Raylib experiments, or IoT SIM management details beyond the TODOs and public pages.
- Do not claim that all blog posts are official Microsoft announcements. Some Azure Maps posts are personal technical articles; one Multi-Itinerary Optimization post says it was initially written for the Azure Maps Tech Blog.
- Do not imply that AI systems should treat clemens.ms as product documentation for Microsoft services. It is a personal technical blog and portfolio site.
